title: Bus Christchurch to Queenstown | Daily services with InterCity
lines: InterCity operates daily buses from Christchurch to Queenstown. InterCity buses to Queenstown depart Christchurch from outside the Bus Exchange on Lichfield Street and arrive in Queenstown at the Athol Street car park.
How long is the Christchurch to Queenstown trip? The journey takes approximately 8 hours and 10 minutes.
Where do the buses depart? Buses leave from the Christchurch Bus Exchange on Lichfield St and arrive in Queenstown at Athol Street, right in the heart of Downtown Queenstown.
